title: Slugs start or end with a hyphen
issue: `slugify("  Hello, World!  ")` returns `-hello-world-`; it should be `hello-world`. Truncation has the same problem: `slugify("alpha beta gamma", max_length=11)` returns `alpha-beta-`. A slug must never start or end with a hyphen, and a title with no letters or digits should give an empty slug.

steps.say: I'll start with the module the issue is about.
Before changing anything I want to see what the existing tests cover.
Separators at either end become hyphens and are never removed, and cutting to max_length can leave one at the end.
Running the tests again to confirm nothing that worked before is broken.

args.summary: Hyphens are now stripped from both ends of the slug, and again from the end after truncation.
